meta.method: English side parsed with spaCy en_core_web_sm; dependencies projected through symmetrized eflomal links (grow-diag); TAM markers additionally read from interlinear glosses where token counts match.
caveats: Rules are statistical summaries, not linguist-verified analyses.
English-parse errors propagate into projected dependencies; Bronze rules are noisiest.
Interlinear-derived TAM inventory exists only for GOLD and SILVER.

resolution_policy.rule: Walk lookup_cascade in order; take the first tier whose rule meets min_support and dominance; otherwise fall through to TIER_4_GENERALIZED.

clause_templates_with_TAM_or_NEG.template: PRON V COMP NEG PRON ARG NEG

valency_frames.dictionary_verb_types_note: Verb_Type column of the dictionary (transitive/intransitive/stative); lexical, highest-priority valency evidence

clause_templates_with_TAM_or_NEG.template: NEG ARG PROG V ARG NEG

TIER_4_GENERALIZED.description: Fallback layer for unseen inputs. Statistics pool Gold, Silver and Bronze with weights 6/2/1 (the same weights as the oversampling).

verb_semantic_class_fallback.analogy_rule: An unseen Mwaghavul verb inherits default_english_roles/default_mw_order of its semantic class (WordNet lexname of its best English equivalent); if the class has no observed frame, use default_argument_structures[0].

rules.guess: ADJ / adjectival nominalizer; head noun precedes (see relation_order.amod)
pluractional / distributive verb or intensified ideophone
locative/dative/future clitic + known stem; analyse stem first
contracted kɨ/kɨ̀ aspect marker after a vowel-final subject (Kɨ_table)
